ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic word means "sunny"? (1 mark)
   A. مُشْمِسٌ
   B. شَمْسٌ
   C. غَائِمٌ
   D. حَارٌّ

2. What does the Arabic sentence أَخِي صَغِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My sister is beautiful.
   B. My grandfather is old (big in age).
   C. Hello, Ahmad.
   D. My brother is small.

3. What does the Arabic sentence جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My grandfather is old (big in age).
   B. My sister is beautiful.
   C. My brother is small.
   D. Hello, Ahmad.

4. What is the name of the Arabic letter ش? (1 mark)
   A. ghayn
   B. shiin
   C. thaa
   D. Haa

5. What does the Arabic sentence كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am a pupil (girl).
   B. I am a pupil (boy).
   C. My name is Ahmad.
   D. How are you? (to a girl)

6. Which Arabic word means "Thursday"? (1 mark)
   A. الْخَمِيسُ
   B. الْأَرْبِعَاءُ
   C. مَدْرَسَةٌ
   D. الْجُمُعَةُ

7. How is the Arabic word صَحْنٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. kitaab
   B. khizaana
   C. hadiiqa
   D. sahn

8. How do you read the syllable دَ? (1 mark)
   A. tu
   B. bi
   C. lu
   D. da

9. What does the Arabic word نَعَمْ (naʿam) mean? (1 mark)
   A. balloon
   B. my turn
   C. congratulations
   D. yes

10. What does the Arabic word أَخٌ (akh) mean? (1 mark)
   A. son
   B. father's sister
   C. brother
   D. mother's brother

11. What does the Arabic word جَوٌّ (jaww) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cloudy
   B. wind
   C. rainy
   D. weather

12. Which Arabic word means "in"? (1 mark)
   A. عِنْدَ
   B. بِجَانِبِ
   C. فِي
   D. خَلْفَ

13. How is the Arabic word طَاوِلَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. taawila
   B. sariir
   C. miftaah
   D. qalam

14. Which family word is written أُخْتٌ? (1 mark)
   A. akh (brother)
   B. umm (mother)
   C. ukht (sister)
   D. ab (father)

15. Which question do you ask when you point to a boy and want to know who he is? (1 mark)
   A. maa ismuka?
   B. kayfa haaluka?
   C. man haadhaa?
   D. man haadhihi?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla (2 marks)

17. Translate into English: aktubu bi-yadii. asmaʿu bi-udhunii. (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into English: ashrabu l-maa'a (2 marks)

19. Translate into English: al-maa'u nadhiif (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: al-mawzu ladhiidh (2 marks)

21. Put these words in order and translate: الْحَفْلَةَ / أُحِبُّ / أَنَا. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into English: uhibbu baytii (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — مُشْمِسٌ
   مُشْمِسٌ (mushmis) means sunny.

2. D — My brother is small.
   أَخِي صَغِيرٌ (akhii Sagiir) means: My brother is small.

3. A — My grandfather is old (big in age).
   جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ (jaddii kabiir) means: My grandfather is old (big in age).

4. B — shiin
   The letter ش is called shiin.

5. D — How are you? (to a girl)
   كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟ (kayfa haaluki?) means: How are you? (to a girl)

6. A — الْخَمِيسُ
   الْخَمِيسُ (al-khamiis) means Thursday.

7. D — sahn
   صَحْنٌ is read sahn and means plate.

8. D — da
   دَ is read da.

9. D — yes
   نَعَمْ (naʿam) means yes.

10. C — brother
   أَخٌ (akh) means brother.

11. D — weather
   جَوٌّ (jaww) means weather.

12. C — فِي
   فِي (fii) means in.

13. A — taawila
   طَاوِلَةٌ is read taawila and means table.

14. C — ukht (sister)
   أُخْتٌ is ukht, sister.

15. C — man haadhaa?
   haadhaa means 'this' for a boy or man. haadhihi is used for a girl or woman.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends are at the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: I write with my hand. I hear with my ear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: The water is clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The banana is delicious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ. I like the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first word, 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the translation.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like my house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
